notes: Panel Settings lays its controls out across the available width instead of one per row. The controls are only around 170 to 220 pixels wide, so a single stacked column left most of every row empty and pushed the window far taller than it…
The reset button no longer carries a text label beside it, which repeated the same word twice. It sits on its own full-width row, aligned right, using the standard button treatment.
Removed the panel Name field. Renaming is not supported for these panels, so the field was an input that could not do anything.
